correctness.rationale: Because every pair of distinct wheel vertices has distance one or two, partial metric isometries are exactly induced graph isomorphisms. Proper rim induced subgraphs are path forests whose cyclicly ordered positive gaps give B_{n,lambda}; their automorphism counts are 2^{t-m_1}∏m_j!. Maps avoiding hub contribute Q_n, those fixing hub contribute zQ_n. All remaining maps fall into finitely many small cone automorphisms or cone-to-rim correspondences, yielding exceptional polynomial 2nz+5n^2z^2+2n^2(n−1)z^3+2n^2z^4. Independently enumerate every possible labeled partial injection with adjacency preserved for n=5,6,7 and reproduce total 957,2534,7737 with complete rank coefficients. The exhaustive *all-n* argument is combinatorial, not inferred from these checks.
residual_risks: n>=5 is necessary: smaller rims have triangle and cone collision behavior outside the stated classification.
